chunks: Do the unbelievers think they can make My own creatures their protectors against Me? We have prepared Hell for the hospitality of infidels.
ai.seo_question: What do disbelievers mistakenly think they can do with God's servants according to Surah Al-Kahf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the polytheistic tendency to elevate righteous servants or angels to the status of divine intermediaries, clarifying that they are merely created beings subject to God's will. It underscores the concept of *Tawhid* in worship, warning that those who attribute divinity to others alongside God face the prepared abode of Hell as a fitting recompense for their spiritual misguidance.
